text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following the historic feat of five GⅠ 
victories, the public was swept up in a 
full-blown "Symboli Rudolf" craze.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli, on the other hand, aimed 
to claim the title of "Derby Umamusume" in 
order to be selected for the Overseas 
Expedition Program.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With an unusually fierce glare in her 
eyes, Sirius Symboli headed off to 
challenge the Japanese Derby.
